sweep.title: Fund sweep
sweep.sub: Deposit addresses → cold wallet. Ethereum, BSC: contract forwarders swept by the server; TRON: offline signing
sweep.notLiveDesc: The fund sweep pages are switched off.
sweep.contractHint: The server signs one batch transaction with the operator account. Each address can only send USDT to the cold wallet (Safe multisig) fixed in the contract; first-time addresses deploy their forwarder in the same transaction. A stolen operator key cannot move the funds.
sweep.offlineHint: TRON uses plain addresses: when preparing, the hot wallet sends 1 TRX to each unactivated address; download the unsigned file on the batch page, sign it offline and import it. On Broadcast the system first rents energy for each address and broadcasts once it arrives, falling back to a TRX top-up if renting fails. The list is valid for 20 hours (TRON transactions expire within 24 hours).
sweep.emptyCandidates: No address is above the threshold
sweep.runDesc: {{chain}}: one batch transaction sweeps {{count}} addresses, about {{usdt}} USDT, all to the cold wallet below.
sweep.prepareDesc: {{chain}}: {{count}} addresses, about {{usdt}} USDT. The hot wallet sends 1 TRX to each unactivated address; after signing and importing, Broadcast rents energy first. Sign and broadcast before the list expires.
sweep.notSignable: Only batches awaiting signature or imported can do this
sweep.broadcastDesc: Broadcast {{count}} verified transactions (rejected ones are not sent).
sweep.cancelDesc: Everything not broadcast is cancelled and will be swept next time; no rent is paid for items not yet rented, and activation TRX stays at the address.
sweep.retryDesc: Failed and deferred addresses go into a new batch.
sweep.noRetry: Only partial, failed or deferred batches can be retried
sweep.expiresHint: This list expires at {{time}}; after that the signatures are void and a new list is needed.
sweep.evmTitle: Contracts and cold wallet (read from chain)
sweep.evmParentHint: The cold wallet (parent) is fixed in every forwarder and in the address formula; the admin cannot change it. To rotate signers, do it in the Safe; the address stays the same.
sweep.targetChangeDesc: Takes effect {{hours}} hours after submission and can be cancelled meanwhile; alert emails are sent on submit and on effect. The offline signer also checks your own saved cold address.
sweep.addressRequired: Enter the new cold wallet address
sweep.addressFormat: A TRON address starts with T and has 34 characters
sweep.cancelChangeTitle: Cancel the pending cold wallet change
sweep.tronTargetHint: Must not be one of our deposit addresses, the hot wallet or the USDT contract.
sweep.autoHint: Off by default: run manually for a month first; deferred while Ethereum gas is above the cap
sweep.tronExpireHint: 1–23 hours; TRON transactions expire within 24 hours on chain
sweep.saveDesc: Saving creates version {{v}}; before/after values go to the audit log.
sweep.tronTopupHint: Used to activate new addresses (1 TRX each) and for the burn fallback
sweep.paramsHint: Thresholds and the fee ratio cap are editable here (Amos 10-20 review). Saving is high-risk, needs a reason and is audited. Defaults are shown under each field.
sweep.maxFeeRatioHint: Addresses whose estimated fee in USD exceeds amount × this ratio are skipped
sweep.evmCapsHint: Mitigation for skipping a third-party audit (SW-4): larger addresses are skipped and swept manually from the Safe; raise gradually, 0 = no cap
sweep.energyHint: Provider: {{provider}} (server config). Energy is rented for each deposit address before broadcasting
sweep.fallbackBurn: Fall back to burning TRX if renting fails
sweep.rentBalanceMinHint: 0 = off; Amos tops up the provider balance, keep it under 1,000 TRX
sweep.rentQuote: Energy rental: {{provider}} quotes {{price}} sun / energy, {{energy}} energy for {{min}} minutes per address (burning is {{burn}} sun / energy)
sweep.rentFlowHint: Energy is ordered only after import, on Broadcast: rent → confirm delivery → broadcast the signed transaction → reclaimed at expiry. Undelivered items fall back to a hot-wallet TRX top-up if enabled.
sweep.burnModeHint: Burn mode: the hot wallet tops up TRX for each address; energy is burned at 100 sun.
sweep.rentBeforeBroadcast: On Broadcast the system rents energy for each verified address and broadcasts once it arrives; items not delivered within 2 minutes fall back to a hot-wallet TRX top-up if enabled.
sweep.nextPhaseTron: TRON sweeping (offline signing + energy rental) is the next phase and is not available yet. TRON deposits are credited as usual.
sweep.nextPhaseSettings: TRON cold wallet, energy rental, auto-sweep, Ethereum gas cap and reminders are the next phase and are hidden for now.
sweep.priceMissing: No ETH / BNB price available: the fee-ratio cap was not checked this time.
sweep.contractsProblem: Contract address configuration problem; deposit addresses still use xpub derivation: {{problem}}
sweep.contractsMissing: Sweep contract addresses are not configured (FC_SWEEP_EVM_*): deposit addresses still use xpub derivation and sweeping is unavailable.
